profile_text.body:
Toyota Research Institute, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Los Altos, California, is a research organization owned by Toyota. According to its website, TRI envisions a future where Toyota products enabled by TRI technology improve quality of life for individuals and society. The organization describes itself as offering a startup environment with talented researchers backed by Toyota's financial resources to solve difficult problems.

TRI operates as a subsidiary of the publicly traded Toyota company. The organization maintains a significant legal exposure profile, with 220 tracked cases in California where it is headquartered.
